notes.title: Maintenance and balancing patch
notes.content:
[p]This patch addresses the Cooldowns problem.
Adds icon on the hud to show player rotation of the skills. Icon size can be adjusted in the settings. 
Weapon skill damage is now additive with main hand weapon's damage, instead of multiplicative. 

Added new type for 'upgrade' item- provides no direct boost to the player, but it increases Rank point or Entire Rank of equipped items. The idea behind this type of items is to help player upgrading their equipment to full during the run. 
This type of item comes in several 'flavours' where it can upgrade all items, random items, items per magic or weapon skill class or their rarity. 

Next patch will finally focus on new map Corduba, along with new class. After that, I will change the skill tree system.

(Thanks Axer and others for the feedback! It is greatly appreciated.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050228/de1c4818152a6d03d8ca965ecd846855b4cecc60.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: minor patch for UI

This small patch addresses the display issues of the Main Menu on ultra-wide screens. 
Additionally, there is a minor adjustment to how equipment slots indicate readiness for an upgrade.

notes.title: Mini skill tree
notes.content:
This update introduces Equipment progression. 

Every equipped skill or main weapon (not off-hand items for now) now features a mini skill tree, allowing players to select upgrades that further refine their current play style. 
To earn points for a specific equipment's mini skill tree, players must select upgrades relevant to that equipment. 
For example, Weapon Damage affects only the main weapon, while Damage All applies to all currently equipped items. Conversely, upgrades like Walk Speed influence only player stats and not equipment.

Hovering over potential upgrades highlights the relevant equipped slots with an orange glow, clearly indicating which items are affected by each upgrade.

To upgrade normal equipment to higher rarity levels, the player must upgrade it multiple times:

[list]
[*]     Rare: Requires 3 upgrades.
[*]     Epic: Requires 6 upgrades.
[*]     Legendary: Requires 8 upgrades.
[*]     Divine: Requires 10 upgrades.
[/list]

notes.title: 2nd attempt at fixing run breaking bug at Level up.

notes.title: Terrain Deformation and Screen Resolution Hotfix 2nd Attempt
notes.content:
- Reworked the application of screen resolution to the game.
- Changed the shader for a non-deformation terrain version. 
Both changes should provide more combability with wider range of HW combinations

notes.title: Dashing update
notes.content:
- The player can now phase through enemies (but not solid objects), dealing high damage in a small area at the end of the dash. Bosses are immune to this attack.

-    Added several upgrades to enhance phasing abilities:
     -   Elemental Path: The player leaves a Fire, Poison, or Lightning path behind after dashing. Increases dash cooldown by 1 second. Dash deals weapon damage, with crit chance scaling with luck. Replaces existing dash damage type.
        - Phase Damage Boost: Increases damage to enemies the player phases through while dashing.
        - Rainbow Path: Randomly selects an elemental damage type for each dash.
        - Dash Distance Extension: Doubles the distance traveled while dashing.
        - Landing Damage AoE: Expands the damage area at the end of the dash.

-    Added damage report tab to Pause, Victory, and Fail screens, showing the damage breakdown by attack type.

-    Fixed several significant bugs reported on Discord and the Community Hub. (Thank you for reporting!)

notes.title: hot fix for poison blade
notes.content:

notes.title: Player Buffs and hot fixes
notes.content:
Added seven buffs that appear randomly during the run:
[list]
[*]     Attack Speed
[*]     Critical Chance
[*]     No Dash Cooldown
[*]     Damage Boost
[*]     Additional Weapon Projectiles
[*]     Additional Skill Projectiles
[*]     XP Boost
[/list]Buffs last about 20-30 seconds, and picking up the same buff twice will refresh its duration. 
Also, fixed several bugs with weapon skill cooldowns. Thanks to ShootToIll for reporting it!

notes.title: Small patch v0.3.06jg
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a level replayability option. Clicking on an already cleared level in the Character Selection screen will relaunch that level instead of progressing to the next one.
[*] Bosses now spawn in the center of the arena to maintain the fast pace of the fight, eliminating the wait for the boss to arrive.
[*] Leveling up equipped items now heals for 10 points of life. If multiple items are leveled up at once, the heal is applied only once.
[/list]

notes.title: First version of Meta progression system is live!
notes.content:
Alongside a myriad of smaller updates and tweaks, we’ve added a brand-new meta progression system called Curriculum Vitae (CV for short).

[list]
[*] Unlocked upgrades are added to the RNG list of upgrades to roll.
[*] Some upgrades can have their values increased further by spending more CV coins.
[*] Some upgrades are defined as Passive, meaning the effects of those upgrades are always applied to the player when starting the game.
[*] To get the CV coins to unlock upgrades, the player needs to kill bosses.
[*] The skill tree can be freely reset with no penalty.
[*] The progression rate is somewhat experimental atm. We aimed not to make it too grindy, but we prefer if players don't clear the board in 45 minutes.
[/list]

Feel free to share your thoughts about the new features here or on our Discord. Huge thanks to our community—your feedback is invaluable! Special thanks to Rag (our Discord member), we appreciate you!

notes.title: Small patch update to 0.2.46
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reworked Gladius Orbitus: much less chance to one-shot a boss.
[*] Cursor is now locked to the screen. There is an option in video settings to disable this.
[*] Fireball now has a more predictable path and should hit enemies more often.
[*] Enemies are now pushed away from the player on level up, plus they have a ~2s freeze animation afterward to give the player more space after leveling up.
[*] After the 1st boss, a healing shrine will spawn, which triggers 10s of regeneration, worth about 50 life. This shrine has no initial timer and will expire only when interacted with by the player.
[*] The list of video resolutions is now based on what the monitor supports. 
[/list]

Next patch will be about auto aim and related controls. ETA - Few days.

notes.title: Small patch update to 0.2.44
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes for BM 0.2.44[/b] 

• Fire wolves' speed reduced from [300-450] to [280-350].
• Two additional magnets will appear during each run.
• Added an option to adjust the low health overlay opacity.
• Increased invulnerability window after leveling up to 2 seconds.
• Extended initial shrine countdown from 30 seconds to 40 seconds.
• Removed few spawn points for shrines to prevent them from appearing in awkward corners of the map.
• Slightly reduced the Fire DoT (Damage over Time) damage values.
• Added an option to reset the progression of each class separately, available on the last screen of the demo. You can revisit this option even after leaving it without resetting.

notes.title: First patch for demo
notes.content:
[b]Most Visible Changes:[/b]
- Max life upgrades increased from 15/25/50/75 to 20/30/40/75.
- Current life upgrades increased from 15/35 to 20/35.
- Burn DoT changed from stacking to refreshing: If the player is already on fire, receiving a new debuf will reset the duration of the debuf but will not add a new stack.
- Charger enemies no longer leave a fire path.
- On unrelated note, Fire wolves now leave a fire path, 
- Fire wolves have more health.
- Explodius is now more dangerous: Their trigger time is shorter, and they have more health.
- Explodius have two different explosion effects:
   - If killed by the player, Explodius blows up and deals damage only to enemies in a larger area.
   - If triggered by player proximity, Explodius turns red and spherical. Standing too close will get you hurt.
- Attempted to prevent critical buttons from failing to launch the game or perform other critical functions.
- Moved the last boss to the very end of the level.
- The settings menu now automatically applies any changes made.

[b]Thank you to everyone for their feedback.[/b]
